tellings.difference: This telling credits nobody, while the story's telling credits Paola Harris and Robert Oppenheimer; it also says only "UFO custody" from the 1940s on, without naming the Trinity craft or the year 1945.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Jacques Vallee's account of the custody chain from the Manhattan Project to the AEC to the DOE's own clearance system, in almost the same words. The "it" in the telling is the craft the story names as the Trinity craft.

as_told.title: UFO custody passed from Manhattan Project to AEC to Department of Energy clearance system

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée tells Michels on two shows that a craft tied to the 1945 Trinity atomic test would have gone to the wartime atomic bomb programme, the Manhattan Project, then to the Atomic Energy Commission, the agency that later ran the US nuclear programme, and then to the Department of Energy, "which has its own line of clearances". In one telling he credits the Italian researcher Paola Harris and mentions J. Robert Oppenheimer. In the other he credits nobody and speaks only of UFO custody from the 1940s on, without naming Trinity. He offers it as a reason why such material could have stayed outside the Pentagon's ordinary oversight.
